nodes.label: STEMdle
nodes.rationale: README defines STEMdle as an engineering and computer science term guessing game with Wordle-like hint gameplay.

nodes.label: Engineering and Computer Science Term Guessing Game
nodes.norm_label: engineering and computer science term guessing game

nodes.label: Progressive Hints
nodes.rationale: Players start with one hint and incorrect guesses reveal increasingly specific hints up to five.

nodes.label: True Engineer
nodes.rationale: README describes True Engineer as mixed mode pulling from all sections.

nodes.label: Game Screen
nodes.rationale: The game screen contains hints, autocomplete search, guess submission, give-up control, and guess history.

nodes.label: Daily Guessing Game
nodes.rationale: The PRD defines STEMdle as a daily guessing game for engineering and computer science terms.

nodes.label: Section Registry
nodes.rationale: A registry maps section IDs and labels to JSON term-bank files; True Engineer is generated by merging registered files.
